dedupe_keys.name: instituto nacional de estadistica public transport datasets

description: Instituto Nacional de Estadística: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estadística. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Personas entre 16 y 65 años cuyo lugar de trabajo o estudios está a me; Transporte urbano: metro y autobus en ciudades que dispongan de metro.; Transporte urbano por autobús por CCAA. TV (Identificador API: 20240); Transporte urbano por autobús por comunidades y ciudades autónomas. TV. Formats seen: HTML, CSV, JSON, PC-AXIS, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.ine.es/aviso_legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
